notes.title: Dream Strikers Demo – Available Now!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Welcome to the Dream Strikers Demo![/b]
This demo offers around [b]30 minutes of gameplay[/b], featuring the core mechanics and thrilling battle modes:[/p][quote][p][b]<VS Mode>[/b]
Supports local 2-player battles – face off against your friends in real-time![/p][p]<[b]Single Player Mode>[/b]
Choose your favorite character in arcade mode and challenge custom AI across multiple stages.[/p][p]<[b]Leaderboard Challenge>[/b]
Take on the arcade challenge mode! Push your limits with different character and stage combinations, and create your own legendary record.[/p][p]🔹[b]Playable Characters:[/b] 4 unique fighters
🔹[b]Battle Arenas:[/b] 8 dreamlike stages with diverse themes, including Sky, Ruins, City, and more
🔹[b]Combat Features:[/b] High-mobility fighting and cinematic finishing moves[/p][/quote][hr][/hr][p]ːsteamthumbsupː[b]We need your feedback![/b]
If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please leave a comment on Steam or join our Discord to share your thoughts with us.[/p][p]Your feedback will help make [b]Dream Strikers[/b] even better![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/sv46CGAsEP" style="button" buttoncolor="#7237fb"]Join Us Discord![/url][/p]
